macros.name: Acolon
macros.doc: To typeset biblical poetry the way it appears in most bibles, begin each line with either \Acolon or \Bcolon. A-colons are typeset flush with the left margin, while B-colons are indented.

macros.name: afterpreludeskip
macros.doc: The vertical distance between the song’s body and its prelude and postlude material is controlled by skips \afterpreludeskip and \beforepostludeskip.

macros.name: alphascale
macros.doc: To return to alphabetic names, type \alphascale.

macros.name: authbyword
macros.doc: To recognize a different word instead of “by”, you can use \authbyword in the document preamble.

macros.name: Bcolon
macros.doc: To typeset biblical poetry the way it appears in most bibles, begin each line with either \Acolon or \Bcolon. A-colons are typeset flush with the left margin, while B-colons are indented.

macros.name: beforepostludeskip
macros.doc: The vertical distance between the song’s body and its prelude and postlude material is controlled by skips \afterpreludeskip and \beforepostludeskip.

macros.name: beginsong
macros.doc: Each \beginsong environment adds a PDF bookmark (if generating a PDF) and hyperlink target (if using the hyperref package) for the song by invoking \songtarget with two arguments: (1) a suggested PDF bookmark level, and (2) a link target name.

macros.name: brk
macros.doc: The \brk macro ends the current column in lyric books by stretching the preceeding text so that the column ends flush with the bottom of the page.

macros.name: capo
macros.doc: Normally, using \capo{⟨n⟩} within a song environment produces a textual note in chord books that suggests the use of a guitar capo on fret ⟨n⟩.

macros.name: cbarwidth
macros.doc: The width of the vertical line that appears to the left of choruses is controlled by the \cbarwidth length.

macros.name: ch
macros.doc: The \ch macro puts a chord atop a ligature without breaking the ligature.

macros.name: chordsoff
macros.doc: Chords can be turned on or off in the middle of the document by using the \chordson or \chordsoff macros.

macros.name: chordson
macros.doc: Chords can be turned on or off in the middle of the document by using the \chordson or \chordsoff macros.

macros.name: chorusjustify
macros.doc: To left-justify or center the lines of verses or choruses, redefine \versejustify or \chorusjustify to \justifyleft or \justifycenter, respectively.

macros.name: chorusmark
macros.doc: To add song information to page headings and footers, redefine \songmark, \versemark, or \chorusmark to add the necessary TeX marks to the current page whenever a new song, verse, or chorus begins.

macros.name: clineparams
macros.doc: To change the vertical distance between chords and the lyrics below them, redefine the \clineparams macro with a definition that adjusts the LaTeX parameters \baselineskip, \lineskiplimit, and \lineskip.

macros.name: colbotglue
macros.doc: When LaTeX ends each column it inserts glue equal to \colbotglue.

macros.name: echo
macros.doc: To typeset an echo part, use \echo{⟨lyrics and chords⟩}.

macros.name: echofont
macros.doc: You can apply additional font changes to verses, choruses, meter numbers, echo parts produced with \echo, and textual notes produced with \textnote and \musicnote, by redefining \versefont, \chorusfont, \meterfont, \echofont, and \notefont, respectively.

macros.name: everychorus
macros.doc: The \everyverse macro is executed at the beginning of each verse, and \everychorus is executed at the beginning of each chorus.

macros.name: everyverse
macros.doc: The \everyverse macro is executed at the beginning of each verse, and \everychorus is executed at the beginning of each chorus.

macros.name: extendpostlude
macros.doc: By default, \extendpostlude prints the song’s copyright and licensing information as a single paragraph using \songcopyright and \songlicense.

macros.name: extendprelude
macros.doc: By default, \extendprelude displays the song’s authors and scripture references using the macros \showauthors and \showrefs.

macros.name: flt
macros.doc: Sharp and flat symbols can be produced with # and & when they appear in chord macros, but if you wish to produce those symbols in other parts of the document, you must use the \shrp and \flt macros.

macros.name: foreachtitle
macros.doc: The \foreachtitle macro accepts LaTeX code as its single argument and executes it once for each (remaining) song title.

macros.name: idxauthfont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset entries of an author index is controlled by \idxauthfont.

macros.name: idxbgcolor
macros.doc: To change the background color of the shaded boxes that contain the capital letters that start each alphabetic sectino of a large title index, redefine \idxbgcolor.

macros.name: idxbook
macros.doc: To control the formatting of the lines that start each new book of the bible in a scripture index, redefine \idxbook, which accepts the book name as its single argument.

macros.name: idxcont
macros.doc: In a scripture index, when a column break separates a block of entries devoted to a book of the bible, the new column is titled “⟨bookname⟩ (continued)” by default. You can change this default by redefining the \idxcont macro, which receives the ⟨bookname⟩ as its single argument.

macros.name: idxheadfont
macros.doc: To change the font used to typeset the capital letters that start each alphabetic section of a large title index, redefine \idxheadfont.

macros.name: idxheadwidth
macros.doc: The \idxheadwidth length defines the width of the shaded boxes that begin each alphabetic block of a large title index.

macros.name: idxlyricfont
macros.doc: Title indexes contain entries for song titles and also entries for notable lines of lyrics. The fonts for these entries are controlled by \idxtitlefont and \idxlyricfont, respectively.

macros.name: idxrefsfont
macros.doc: To control the formatting of the list of references on the right-hand side of index entries, redefine \idxrefsfont.

macros.name: idxscripfont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset entries of a scripture index is controlled by \idxscripfont.

macros.name: idxtitlefont
macros.doc: Title indexes contain entries for song titles and also entries for notable lines of lyrics. The fonts for these entries are controlled by \idxtitlefont and \idxlyricfont, respectively.

macros.name: indexesoff
macros.doc: Display of indexes can also be turned on or off using the \indexeson and \indexesoff macros.

macros.name: indexeson
macros.doc: Display of indexes can also be turned on or off using the \indexeson and \indexesoff macros.

macros.name: indextitleentry
macros.doc: \indextitleentry may be used to add an alternate title for the song to the index.

macros.name: lastcolglue
macros.doc: Glue of size \lastcolglue is inserted at the bottom of the last column.

macros.name: lrep
macros.doc: Create a begin-repeat sign.

macros.name: lyricfont
macros.doc: Define the font style to use for formatting song lyrics.

macros.name: makepostlude
macros.doc: By default, \makeprelude displays the song’s titles, authors, and scripture references to the right of a shaded box containing the song’s number; and \makepostlude displays the song’s copyright and licensing information in fine print.

macros.name: makeprelude
macros.doc: By default, \makeprelude displays the song’s titles, authors, and scripture references to the right of a shaded box containing the song’s number; and \makepostlude displays the song’s copyright and licensing information in fine print.

macros.name: mch
macros.doc: The \mch macro is exactly like the \ch macro except that it also places a measure bar into the ligature along with the chord.

macros.name: measurebar
macros.doc: Make a measure bar using the most recently defined meter.

macros.name: measuresoff
macros.doc: Measure bars can also be turned on or off in the middle of the document by using the \measureson or \measuresoff macros.

macros.name: measureson
macros.doc: Measure bars can also be turned on or off in the middle of the document by using the \measureson or \measuresoff macros.

macros.name: memorize
macros.doc: By default, chords are replayed from the current song’s first verse, but you can replay the chords of a different verse or chorus by saying \memorize at the beginning of any verse or chorus whose chords you want to later replay.

macros.name: meter
macros.doc: Set the current meter without producing an actual measure bar yet.

macros.name: meterfont
macros.doc: You can apply additional font changes to verses, choruses, meter numbers, echo parts produced with \echo, and textual notes produced with \textnote and \musicnote, by redefining \versefont, \chorusfont, \meterfont, \echofont, and \notefont, respectively.

macros.name: minfrets
macros.doc: Define the minimum number of fret rows that should appear in tablature diagrams.

macros.name: MultiwordChords
macros.doc: The \MultiwordChords macro forces multiple words to be squeezed under one chord by default.

macros.name: musicnote
macros.doc: Create a textual note for musicians.

macros.name: newauthorindex
macros.doc: Define a new author index.

macros.name: newchords
macros.doc: Allocate a new chord-replay register to hold memorized chords.

macros.name: newindex
macros.doc: Define a new title index.

macros.name: newsongkey
macros.doc: Defining a new key for \beginsong is just like the keyval package’s \define@key macro except that we must also define some initializer code for each key.

macros.name: nextcol
macros.doc: The \nextcol macro ends the column by leaving blank space at the bottom.

macros.name: nexttitle
macros.doc: To get the song’s next title, execute \nexttitle, which sets \songtitle to be the next title in the song’s list of titles (or sets \songtitle to \relax if there are no more titles).

macros.name: nolyrics
macros.doc: To make the chords in such a line sit on the baseline instead of raised above it, use the \nolyrics macro.

macros.name: norepchoruses
macros.doc: Writing \norepchoruses turns off chorus repetition for subsequent songs.

macros.name: nosongnumbers
macros.doc: To turn off song numbering entirely, type \nosongnumbers.

macros.name: notebgcolor
macros.doc: The colors of shaded boxes containing textual notes and song numbers can be changed by redefining the \notebgcolor and \snumbgcolor macros.

macros.name: notejustify
macros.doc: Textual notes are fully justified when they are too long to fit in a single line.

macros.name: notenamesout
macros.doc: Set the note names that are output by the transposition logic.

macros.name: notrans
macros.doc: Suppress chord transposition without suppressing note name conversion.

macros.name: noversenumbers
macros.doc: To turn off verse numbering entirely, use \noversenumbers.

macros.name: pagepreludes
macros.doc: Writing \pagepreludes typesets subsequent preludes at page width atop fresh pages, with the rest of the song in multiple columns beneath its title.

macros.name: placenote
macros.doc: Textual notes are placed flush-left.

macros.name: placeversenum
macros.doc: Verse numbers are placed flush-left.

macros.name: printchord
macros.doc: Define the printing style for chords.

macros.name: printscrcite
macros.doc: Define the printing style for the citation at the end of a scripture quotation.

macros.name: printsongnum
macros.doc: Define the printing style for the large, boxed song numbers starting each song.

macros.name: printversenum
macros.doc: Define the printing style for the verse numbers to the left of each verse.

macros.name: rep
macros.doc: To indicate that a line should be sung multiple times by all singers, put \rep{⟨n⟩} at the end of the line.

macros.name: repchoruses
macros.doc: Using \repchoruses causes choruses to be automatically repeated on subsequent pages of the song.

macros.name: replay
macros.doc: Saying \replay stops any memorization and begins replaying memorized chords.

macros.name: resettitles
macros.doc: Initialize the title list iterator.

macros.name: rrep
macros.doc: Create an end-repeat sign.

macros.name: sbarheight
macros.doc: The height of the horizontal line that appears between each pair of songs is controlled by the \sbarheight length.

macros.name: scleardpage
macros.doc: Move to the next even-numbered page if the current page is odd or nonempty.

macros.name: sclearpage
macros.doc: Move to the next page if the current page is nonempty.

macros.name: scripindent
macros.doc: Create an indented sub-block within a scripture quotation.

macros.name: scripoutdent
macros.doc: You can increase the indentation level within a scripture quotation by using \scripindent and decrease it by using \scripoutdent.

macros.name: scriptureoff
macros.doc: You can also turn scripture quotations on or off in the middle of the document by using \scriptureon or \scriptureoff, respectively.

macros.name: scriptureon
macros.doc: You can also turn scripture quotations on or off in the middle of the document by using \scriptureon or \scriptureoff, respectively.

macros.name: setlicense
macros.doc: The user sets the licensing info for the current song with this command.

macros.name: shiftdblquotes
macros.doc: The \shiftdblquotes macro allows one to modify the spacing around all double-quotes until the current group ends.

macros.name: showauthors
macros.doc: Display the author information in the prelude.

macros.name: showrefs
macros.doc: Display the scripture references in the prelude.

macros.name: slides
macros.doc: Slides mode can be activated in the middle of the document by using the \slides macro.

macros.name: solfedge
macros.doc: By default, the transposition logic only understands alphabetic names, but you can tell it to look for solfedge names by typing \solfedge.

macros.name: songauthors
macros.doc: To get the current song’s list of authors (if any) use \songauthors.

macros.name: songcolumns
macros.doc: The number of columns per page can be set with \songcolumns.

macros.name: songcopyright
macros.doc: To get the current song’s copyright info (if any), use \songcopyright.

macros.name: songlicense
macros.doc: To get the current song’s licensing information (if any), use \songlicense.

macros.name: songlink
macros.doc: Links in indexes to these targets are created by \songlink, which also gets two arguments: (1) the link target name (same as the second argument to \songtarget), and (2) the text to be linked.

macros.name: songlist
macros.doc: When \includeonlysongs is used to extract a partial list of songs, the \songlist macro expands to the comma-separated list of songs that is being extracted.

macros.name: songmark
macros.doc: To add song information to page headings and footers, redefine \songmark, \versemark, or \chorusmark to add the necessary TeX marks to the current page whenever a new song, verse, or chorus begins.

macros.name: songnumwidth
macros.doc: The \songnumwidth length defines the width of the shaded boxes that contain song numbers at the beginning of each song.

macros.name: songrefs
macros.doc: To get the current song’s list of scripture references (if any) use \songrefs.

macros.name: songsection
macros.doc: Format the section header for a section in a song book.

macros.name: songtitle
macros.doc: The \songtitle macro yields the current song’s title.

macros.name: spenalty
macros.doc: The value of \spenalty controls the undesirability of column breaks at song boundaries.

macros.name: stitlefont
macros.doc: Define the font style to use for formatting song titles.

macros.name: strophe
macros.doc: Insert blank space indicative of a strophe division in a scripture quotation.

macros.name: textnote
macros.doc: Create a textual note for singers and musicians.

macros.name: versejustify
macros.doc: To left-justify or center the lines of verses or choruses, redefine \versejustify or \chorusjustify to \justifyleft or \justifycenter, respectively.

macros.name: versemark
macros.doc: To add song information to page headings and footers, redefine \songmark, \versemark, or \chorusmark to add the necessary TeX marks to the current page whenever a new song, verse, or chorus begins.

macros.name: versenumwidth
macros.doc: The \versenumwidth length defines the horizontal space reserved for verse numbers to the left of each verse text.

macros.name: versesep
macros.doc: The vertical distance between song verses and song choruses is defined by the skip register \versesep.

envs.name: intersong
envs.doc: Material contributed in an intersong environment is subject to the same columnbreaking rules as songs (see §11.5), but all other formatting is up to you.

envs.name: songgroup
envs.doc: Each songgroup environment may include any number of intersong, intersong*, or scripture quotations (see §8.2), but must include exactly one song.
